subject: FY25 School Budget Priorities
overview: The committee reviewed FY25 budget pressures, including $7.5 million in projected spending needs across contractual obligations, underfunded accounts, expiring ESSER funds, and new expenses. District leadership and committee members discussed potential revenue offsets, spending reductions, and a projected gap against the city's preliminary allocation.

items.title: FY25 Budget Overview and Spending Priorities
items.summary: CFO Gerry McCue presented projected FY25 budgetary pressures totaling $7.5 million across contractual obligations, historically underfunded operational accounts, 21.2 positions transitioning from expiring ESSER funding, and new technology and facilities needs against minimal projected Chapter 70 aid growth.

items.title: Committee Discussion on Budget Gap and Priorities
items.summary: Committee members discussed the gap between projected needs and the city's preliminary $73.5 million allocation, emphasizing that Chromebook replacements, non-discretionary ELL staffing, and contractual commitments must be planned for within the operating budget.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Medford Teachers Association president Anthony Geehan inquired about the specific ESSER positions targeted for reduction and asked about access to public records on revolving funds, facility rental revenue, and the timeline for sharing the proposed budget with union leadership.
